gizmo.title: Kiʻikuhi mai ke kikokikona
gizmo.description: E kākau i kiʻikuhi ma ke ʻano he kikokikona (Mermaid): he kiʻikuhi kahe, kaʻina, laina manawa a me nā mea hou aku. Kaha ʻia ma ka ʻaoʻao me kahi kikokikona pani.

configure.title: Poʻo inoa
configure.description: Hōʻike ʻia ma luna o ke kiʻikuhi a hoʻohana ʻia ma ke ʻano he inoa nona.

configure.title: Kumu kiʻikuhi
configure.description: Kikokikona Mermaid, no ka laʻana: flowchart TD, a laila hoʻokahi laina no kēlā me kēia loulou e like me A[Draft] --> B{Ready?}. E hoʻohui iā |label| ma hope o kekahi pua e lepili ai. Hōʻano hou ke kaha kiʻi ʻoiai ʻoe e kikokiko ana.

configure.title: Kikokikona pani
configure.description: E wehewehe i ka mea a ke kiʻikuhi e hōʻike ai no ka poʻe hiki ʻole ke ʻike iā ia. E waiho hakahaka ma kahi kiʻikuhi kahe i papa inoa ʻia kona mau ʻanuʻu nou.

configure.title: Kākau kiʻi
configure.description: Kākau kiʻi koho i hōʻike ʻia ma lalo o ke kiʻikuhi.

configure.title: Hōʻike i ke kumu
configure.description: Hōʻike i ke kikokikona kiʻikuhi ma ka ʻaoʻao o ke kaha kiʻi.

configure.title: Hōʻike i ke kikokikona pani
configure.description: Hōʻike i ke kikokikona pani ma lalo o ke kaha kiʻi. Loaʻa mau ia i nā mea heluhelu pakuhi.

advanced.title: Waihona kumu
advanced.description: Helu wahi o kahi waihona .mmd e kaha ai ma kahi o ke kikokikona ma luna (https a i ʻole ala ma kēia kahua).

advanced.title: Waihoʻoluʻu koʻikoʻi
advanced.description: Waihoʻoluʻu o ka ʻāpana kiʻi ikona ma ke poʻo.
